name: fiend_facing
title: Gunman facing (owner 2026-10-25: our NPCs turn sideways while shooting at their target): a Fiend gunman alone against the player standing still in god mode where Violet's dogs roam near Goodsprings, as in gun_reach. killall clears the dogs; the player is turned to face north (GetAngle Z 0) and the Fiend is moved 400 units north of the player, close and in view, then set on the player. Every game loop, the fight field set: the shooter's heading against the bearing to the player while it attacks (GetAnimAction 2 or 3).
